mapper.select: select TO_CHAR(B.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as tradeDate /* 交易日期 */ from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B where B.TRADE_ID = #{finprodId}
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT SET PRIN = #{prin,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, VDATE = to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), MDATE = to_date(#{mdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
